label: Feishu / Lark
terms_note: Automation allowed for an internal (自建) or store app: POST /open-apis/auth/v3/tenant_access_token/internal {app_id, app_secret} → token ≤7200 s; Send POST /open-apis/im/v1/messages?receive_id_type=open_id|user_id|union_id|email|chat_id with msg_type text / post / interactive (card) / share_chat / share_user / image / video / audio / file / sticker; permission one of im:message, im:message:send_as_bot, im:message:send; limits: 1,000 requests / minute and 50 / second per app, 5 / second per user, 5 / second per group shared by all bots; text ≤150 KB, cards / rich text ≤30 KB; bot must be in the group to post there; optional uuid (≤50 chars) dedups for 1 hour; error codes 230020 rate limit, 230025 too large, 230053 user blocked the bot, 232009 group dissolved. Reading 'all group messages' is a sensitive scope needing admin approval (registry note).

sdks: Official Lark open SDKs (Go, Java, Python, Node.js) + long-connection (WebSocket) event client — open.larksuite.com

endpoints.notes: needs the sensitive scope for groups

endpoints.call: Event subscription `im.message.receive_v1`, `im.chat.member.bot.added_v1` (HTTP callback with challenge / encrypt key, or WebSocket)

reference.limits: - Error codes with HTTP 200: `230020` frequency limit → `RateLimited`; `230025` content too large; `230053` user blocked the bot; `232009` group dissolved. msg_types: text, post, interactive, share_chat, share_user, image, video, audio, file, sticker. - Bot must be in a group to post there; DMs only to users in the tenant who can see the app (availability scope).

fields.name: app_id
fields.help: App ID of a Feishu custom (self-built) app with the bot capability (cli_…); exchanged with app_secret at POST /open-apis/auth/v3/tenant_access_token/internal for a tenant_access_token (max 2 hours).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: App Secret of the same app (developer console, Credentials & Basic Info).

me.note: Bot info: account.bot carries app_name, open_id, activate_status. Needs the bot capability enabled.

list_inbound.note: History of ONE chat (`channel` = chat_id oc_…, required; the bot must be in the chat), newest first; page_size 1–50. text is body.content, a JSON string such as {"text":"…"}; sent_at is create_time in milliseconds. Paging is by page_token, so `page` is ignored; `since` is not sent (start_time takes Unix seconds).

get_thread.note: All messages of a topic thread (`thread_id` = omt_… from a message's thread_id), oldest first; `page` is ignored.

send.note: Text message to `to`, interpreted per config receive_id_type (chat_id oc_… by default choice; the bot must be in the chat, or the user within the app's availability scope). `content` is sent as the serialized JSON string {"text": …} the API requires; `uuid` de-duplicates retries. `subject`/`channel` are ignored.

reply.note: Replies to the message `thread_id` (a message id om_…, e.g. a list_inbound id) with a text message; `channel` is not needed.

not_offered.mark_read: There is no API for a bot to mark messages read; read receipts are only queryable (https://open.feishu.cn/document/server-docs/im-v1/message/read_users).

adapter.envelope_note: Every Open Platform response carries `code` ('错误码，非 0 取值表示失败') and `msg`; a non-zero code becomes an isError result.

config_fields.name: receive_id_type
config_fields.help: How `send`'s `to` is interpreted (receive_id_type query parameter): chat_id (group or p2p chat oc_…, the usual choice), open_id, union_id, user_id or email. Set it to chat_id unless you address users directly.

evidence: host open.feishu.cn: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
